Download every kernels[].url to its named file under a separate kernel directory and verify each SHA-256. Preserve the kernel files and embedded notices unchanged.
Pass the two directories to llr_residuals.py via --data-dir and --kernel-dir, with an explicit --output-dir. No network access occurs during model evaluation.
earth_orientation: Uses the existing default IERS20 Earth rotation and matching clock configuration. Runtime output records hashes of the actual Earth-orientation resource files; no assertion that these equal the historical JPL fit EOP.

analysis_frame_alias.purpose: Analysis-only identity alias from ICRF to SPICE J2000; modern DE440 SPK and PA orientation products use ICRF axes. Removes the unintended SOFA dynamical-J2000 bias from Earth rotation without altering native frame semantics.
analysis_frame_alias.load_order: After the six unchanged provider kernels, only for the default ICRF analysis route.
